description: Immutable weekly snapshots of The Saturday Slate. Each file is the exact standalone page published that week, including its predictions and playoff-probability estimates as of that edition. Never edit a past edition in place; git history also preserves every version.

editions.note: First edition of the upgraded publication (front page, playoff outlook, enhanced previews). Iowa #17 / Iowa State / Vikings all on bye; GOTW Ohio State @ Indiana.

Miami new AP No. 1 after Georgia's loss; Iowa up to No. 15. All three big teams back from byes (Iowa at Minnesota, Iowa State at Arizona, Vikings vs Colts). Final week of the Iowa HS regular season. GOTW Ole Miss @ Texas.
